title: Prior-Use Schedule for Reinstated Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Schedule of prior-use months counted in the reinstated term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers. The months depend on the number of redemption entries the credit carries on its value history.

| Redemption entries on the credit | Prior-use months |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 months |
| 1 | 1 month |
| none | none |

**Schedule rule.** The prior-use months of a reinstated credit are 2 months when the credit carries at least 2 redemption entries, 1 month when it carries at least one but fewer than 2 redemption entries, and none when it carries no redemption entry.

**Notes to the schedule.**
1. The count is of redemption entries on this credit's own value history.
2. The threshold of 2 entries counts as reached at exactly 2.

**Hypothetical reading.** A credit whose value history shows a load entry, two redemption entries and an expiry write-off entry carries 2 redemption entries, so 2 prior-use months. With only one redemption entry it would be 1 month. With a load entry and a write-off entry and no redemption entry, there are none.
